name: Screenshot a Page (Mobile Viewport)
description: Capture a mobile-viewport (390x844) screenshot of any URL or running Vrooli scenario. Scenario shorthand applies the target's declared readiness surface, so responsive checks do not need caller-provided sleeps or selectors.

out.description: Directory the screenshot is written into; relative paths resolve under BAS's captures storage root.

url.description: Prefer `scenario=<slug>,path=<path>` shorthand: it resolves the port and applies the scenario's declared readiness profile. Raw http(s) URLs get only generic navigation readiness and may capture a still-loading page unless waitFor is set.

waitFor.description: Optional readiness override: CSS selector, 'networkidle', or timeout in ms. Omit for scenario-shorthand URLs (declared readiness profile applies). Set it for raw http(s) URLs of dynamic pages, which otherwise wait only for navigation.

executionId.description: BAS execution id; reuse with `browser-automation-studio executions get`.

primaryArtifactPath.description: Path of the final screenshot artifact, marked primary=true in BAS JSON.

examples.description: Mobile screenshot of an RCL component after its declared rendered-story readiness surface settles.
